description: Create a retrievable, non-binding quote snapshot for published merchant SKUs. Each quantity must be an integer, meet the SKU MOQ, and not exceed confirmed sellable inventory; destination.country must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Real order creation remains disabled until production settlement and fulfillment are ready.

destination.description: Buyer delivery destination used for the non-binding quote.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as US or GB.

environment.description: Catalog environment. Only production listings can produce a quote.

items.description: At least one requested line with sku and a positive integer quantity.

quantity.description: Requested units; must meet the product MOQ.

name: create_quote

outputSchema.description: Retrievable non-binding quote snapshot with expiry, items, supplier options and totals. shipping is the numeric amount for compatibility; shippingEstimate contains the full estimate and assumptions.
